title: Stopped Waiting Is Not the Same as Failed
description: A checkout call times out after the payment service may have committed the charge. What can the caller conclude?

options.text: The remote transaction must have rolled back.
options.explanation: A local timeout does not determine the remote transaction's outcome.

options.text: The outcome is uncertain; recover using the same operation identity or a status query.
options.explanation: The caller stopped waiting, but the effect may exist. Idempotency and reconciliation are needed before treating a retry as safe.

options.text: A new payment identity is always safe after a timeout.
options.explanation: A fresh identity can create another charge if the first attempt succeeded.

options.text: Retrying forever eventually proves only one charge happened.
options.explanation: Unbounded retries increase load and cannot establish uniqueness without an effect-level guarantee.
